privacy.title: Privacy & Data Deletion
privacy.subtitle: Your documents belong to you. We operate on a strict zero-persistent-storage architecture.
privacy.modelExplanationTitle: How AI Legal Guardian Protects Your Privacy:
privacy.rule1: No Accounts: We do not collect names, emails, phone numbers, or passwords.
privacy.rule2: Temporary Memory Only: Documents and transcripts exist strictly in transient RAM during your active session.
privacy.rule3: Automatic TTL Expiration: Inactive sessions and all temporary artifacts are automatically purged after 30 minutes.
privacy.rule4: Explicit Deletion: Clicking 'Delete Document' or 'End Session' completely wipes all server-side copies instantly.
privacy.providerRetentionNotice: Important Note on Privacy: All processing is transient and strictly ephemeral. Documents and transcripts are purged immediately upon session closure.
privacy.confirmClear: This will immediately wipe all uploaded files, extracted texts, analyses, translations, and chat history. This action cannot be undone.
privacy.dataClearedSuccess: Session ended successfully. All memory records have been purged.
